guarantees.title: Provider credential reference confinement

guarantees.title: Version 1 local-trust deployment boundary
guarantees.claim_summary: Version 1 server deployment is limited to loopback or local-trusted access, while production authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and multi-user isolation remain outside the classified capability.

failure_semantics: A server service publishes a remotely reachable host port while relying on the local-trust assumption.

QT-TERM-054 remains a proposed distinction between deployment validation and external execution authority.
The configuration test does not establish a deployed-network penetration result.

guarantees.title: Bot Run lease ownership
guarantees.claim_summary: Each Bot Run is governed by one renewable owner lease whose raw token remains caller-owned while only its hash is persisted, and mutation is rejected after mismatch, expiry, or ownership loss.
claim_scope: Bot Run lease acquisition, renewal, validation, release, and ownership checks represented by the named paths.
Persisted token-hash and caller-held raw-token handling at frozen baseline d46e40bf.
failure_semantics: A caller mutates a Bot Run after lease mismatch, expiry, or ownership loss.
A raw lease token is persisted in place of its hash.
Concurrent starts produce more than one effective active owner.
wording_constraints: Lease, claim, lock, heartbeat, token, and generation remain contrasted under proposed QT-TERM-050.
Named service tests exercise representative acquisition and stale-scan paths but not the complete database lease state machine.
The accepted ADR is a durable decision record and does not activate this registry entry.

guarantees.title: Asynchronous job ownership fencing
guarantees.claim_summary: Asynchronous job effects are committed only under the current ownership token and generation, preventing a stale owner from committing after reclaim or lease loss.
claim_scope: Asynchronous job claim, heartbeat, reclaim, completion, and domain-effect transaction paths represented by the named repository.
Ownership token and generation persistence at frozen baseline d46e40bf.
failure_semantics: A stale worker commits completion or a job-owned domain effect after reclaim.
Job completion and its associated domain effects commit outside one ownership-fenced transaction.
Ownership validation omits either the token or the generation.
wording_constraints: Async Job and job-owned effect remain deferred terminology under QT-TERM-051.
Lease, claim, and ownership fence remain proposed and contrasted under QT-TERM-050.
The database tests cover named ownership races and transactions, not every future asynchronous effect type.

guarantees.title: Enumerated agent mutation gates

Implementation guards on named paths are evidence only and do not resolve the ADR contradiction.
Qualified Evidence under QT-TERM-026 remains proposed and does not create new promotion semantics.

notes.text: All sixteen records are unactivated drafts; accepted ADRs, AGENTS.md, implementation, tests, and this registry batch remain nonactivating under the frozen Phase 2A authority hierarchy.
Fourteen records are conservatively partially_enforced because each has named intent and implementation evidence but incomplete proof, incomplete closed-surface coverage, or stale documentation.
GC062 and GC066 are contradicted rather than partially_enforced because their cited accepted ADR text contains unresolved normative-scope or amendment conflicts already recorded in Phase 1.

The frozen workflow contains four jobs; non-database, frontend, and deployment each have a job, while clean bootstrap and database-marked verification are separate steps in the clean-database-bootstrap job.
QT-PROOF-300 through QT-PROOF-316 are proposed proof definitions only; no selector was executed and no result is asserted by this batch.

No newly discovered term or conflict is introduced; all referenced QT-TERM and finding IDs already exist in the Phase 1 inventory or proposed glossary, remain unadopted where proposed or deferred, and are not resolved here.
